WITH country_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) as avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as avg_wins_global
  FROM country_stats
)
SELECT 
  cs.country,
  ROUND(cs.avg_points, 2) as avg_points,
  ROUND(cs.avg_wins, 2) as avg_wins,
  ROUND(cs.avg_wins - ga.avg_wins_global, 2) as difference_from_global_avg
FROM country_stats cs
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
ORDER BY cs.country
